headline: Ravens Regime: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Ravens Regime is projected #5 of 16 with a 631.90 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Lamar Jackson, Kyle Pitts, and Derrick Henry. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

latest_trade.summary: On July 26, Ravens Regime traded with Corgi Loaf Baking Co. and acquired Isaac TeSlaa, Kyle Pitts, 2026 Round 1 (Rapid Valley Annihilation) while sending Tyler Warren, 2026 Round 1 (Ravens Regime), 2028 Round 1 (Ravens Regime). Isaac TeSlaa is now on the current roster at 36.0 C-AVI and 55.6 D-AVI; Kyle Pitts is now the current TE starter at 93.9 C-AVI and 87.0 D-AVI; The deal sent out 2 draft assets, reducing future flexibility; The deal added 1 draft asset.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Romeo Doubs's 54.6 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 80.5 C-AVI would directly attack the 25.90-point projected gap to SmokyValleyWheatWarriors.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.
